content.en_us: Simple earlygame machine for grinding various types of rocks and stones into dust. Recipes typically need water and produce colloid as a byproduct. Using a cobblestone generator or other automated source of rock, the rock mill can serve as an early source of a small number of materials, such as quartz, flint, [[fluorite||Fluorite]] and [[boron|Boron]], among several other minor byproducts.
